captions.caption: A person wraps a fish in a large green leaf.
A wood fire burns inside a primitive mud oven.
A hand reaches toward the fire inside the oven.
The leaf-wrapped fish is placed on a stone over the fire.
A person uses a stick to adjust the cooking fish.
A man sits by his hut, holding a gourd.
Water is poured from a gourd onto the cooking fish.
Steam rises as water hits the hot cooking surface.
The man continues pouring water over the leaf-wrapped fish.
A view of the oven through hanging green leaves.
A woven mat is laid out on a flat stone.
Sticks are used to move the cooked fish onto the mat.
The man prepares to open the charred leaf package.
Hands peel back the leaf to reveal the cooked fish.
The man takes a bite of the freshly cooked fish.
Close-up of hands pulling white meat from the fish.
The man separates the meat from the fish's skeleton.
A hand reaches for elderberries with text "Elderberry Wine".
Elderberries are picked from a bush into a basket.
A bunch of white elderberries is held in a hand.
More elderberries are dropped into the woven basket.
The basket is filled with white elderberries.
The man holds the basket high in a sunny field.
The man brings the basket down after showing his harvest.
Hands mix the harvested elderberries inside the basket.
Elderberries are crushed in a stone mortar.
A person grinds the berries using their fingers.
The man continues processing berries inside his dwelling.
Hands squeeze the juice from the crushed elderberries.
A handful of pulpy elderberry remains is shown.
Water is poured from a gourd into a clay pot.
Liquid streams into the pot containing crushed berries.
Bubbles form on the surface of the berry mixture.
The berry-filled pot is left to sit in the dwelling.
A woven square mat is prepared as a pot cover.
Hands hold the woven cover over the clay pot.
The woven mat is placed on top of the pot.
The man adjusts the cover on the fermenting pot.
The man removes the cover to check the fermentation.
The man stirs the elderberry wine with his bare hand.
The man reaches into the pot to sample the liquid.
Wine is strained through a small basket into a bowl.
The man lifts a small clay bowl to his lips to drink.
The man takes a sip of the elderberry wine.
The man smiles and enjoys the drink inside the hut.
Transition to a dark scene showing patterns on a wall.
The interior of the hut is illuminated by a dim light source.
The man lies down to sleep inside the hut.
Close-up of the man's face as he rests.
The man's chest moves as he breathes while sleeping.
A hand reaches for a plant with the text "Black Sage Seed".
Close-up of black sage seeds being harvested.
The man collects seeds from the plants in the field.
Seeds are shaken from a container into a small bowl.
A pile of small brown seeds is shown in the bowl.
A hand spreads out the seeds in the bowl.
Close-up of the small brown black sage seeds.
The man tastes a few of the seeds he collected.
The man holds the basket of seeds in the field.
A close-up of a hand covering a stone bowl.
